text.en:
The qualified members of the medicare program shall without any additional contribution, be entitled
to the following allowances:
TYPE OF BENEFIT
Allowances for Members
1. Room and Board
1.1 Primary Care Hospitals
1.2 Secondary Care Hospitals
1.3 Tertiary Care Hospitals
2. Drugs/Laboratory Examination
2.1 For Ordinary Cases
2.2 For Cases Requiring Intensive Care
3. Surgeon's Fees
3.1 Minor Surgery
3.2 Medium Surgery
3.3 Major Surgery

4. Operating Room Fee
4.1 Minor Surgery
4.2 Medium Surgery
4.3 Major Surgery
5. Anesthesiologist's Fee
30% of surgeon's fee
6. Medical/Dental Practitioner's Fee
6.1 For Ordinary Cases
6.2 For Cases Requiring Intensive Care Maximum
7. Allowance for Sterilization
7.2 Tubaligation

The legal dependents of Medicare members shall continue to be entitled to the allowance presently
prescribed in Section 12 of Presidential Decree No. 1519.

Presidential Decree No. 1519 and all laws, executive orders or parts thereof which are inconsistent
with the provisions of this order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 1st day of May, in the year of Our Lord nineteen hundred and eighty four.
